name: traceroute:owner
description: Full owner management. Reviewed ChatGPT and Claude OAuth sign-in establishes the default account connection.

attributes.consent.screen.text: Read and manage your Traceroute record: logging, corrections, settings, sharing and deletion. Everything you record, including device data and anything about reproductive or sexual health, is treated as health data. Traceroute stores it only to provide the service and never sells it. Data this app handles also passes through its provider. Withdraw by removing the connector. Details: traceroutehealth.com/privacy
